summary: Black Hills summit in Pennington County, SD; a 1929 field tower was announced, a 1940s summit tower was later removed, and the site is listed as gone. Present condition unknown.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com and the Fire Lookout Association list say gone; a climbing site says a 1940s summit tower was since removed; no removal date given

notes_for_editor: Sparse record. The 1929 item is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the Deadwood paper itself was not opened, so whether the tower went up in 1929 is open. The 1940s date is decade-only and comes from a Peakery highlight line; no year is given. Fact-check 2026-10-10: added the 1940s wording to the evidence quote, the SDPB publication date (June 23, 2020) and the Crow Peak name to the evidence list, and a 1940s event. Elevation differs by 5 ft between firelookout.com (7049 ft) and Peakery (7,044 ft); the record's elevation_m is still null and could take a value once the editor picks one. A search surfaced a Black Hills fire-tower page and a 2020 SDPB list; only the SDPB list was read. No access rules or present-day site description were found.
